biomarkers.name: Same as MDS_SLD (cytogenetics, NGS panel, IPSS-R/IPSS-M)

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Bone marrow dysplasia (e510% dysplastic cells) in e52 lineages with peripheral cytopenia in e51 lineage; blasts <5% in marrow and <1% in blood
variants: MDS-MLD is the largest single MDS category

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: As per MDS_SLD; multilineage involvement indicates more advanced clonal expansion
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow with dyspoiesis in multiple lineages

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC with clonal expansion producing ineffective haematopoiesis affecting multiple lineages
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Dysplastic differentiation in e52 lineages with peripheral cytopenia in e51 lineage; represents more advanced clonal expansion than SLD
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same clonal haematopoiesis biology as SLD but with more advanced lineage involvement  reflects further evolution of clonal disease affecting multiple committed progenitors
